scope: Training-only native real-Q discovery calibration; no production selector, NDE, Q or PPO change

cases.secondary_rule: Different state; prefer a different mechanism, then highest interaction mass

later_actions: Unchanged natural NDE; only initial decision is tilted
conditional_law: Uniform selected source episode, then uniform selected eligible cases within source; controls retained separately

ranker.target: CAV first-event frequency under fixed dual Q, not natural risk or variance
ranker.validation: Leave one complete source episode out; training diagnostic only, never deploy without fresh validation

fixed_budget_rule: Freeze before opening source episodes. Retain every selected case and continuation, no replacement or event-conditioned budget increase. No consumed validation labels enter fitting.
